requirement: The system shall prevent a member from borrowing an additional item when they already hold the maximum permitted number of open loans.
The system shall calculate a late fee for each overdue loan at the configured daily rate, capped at the replacement value of the item.
The user selects a title in the catalogue; the system checks whether a copy is free and, if so, records the loan and sets the due date two weeks ahead.
The user enters a reservation request for a title that is currently unavailable; the system queues it and notifies the member when a copy is returned.
As a member, I want to search the catalogue by title or author so that I can find items to borrow.
As a librarian, I want to mark a loan as returned so that the item becomes available and any outstanding charge is settled.
A loan may only be renewed when no other member is waiting for that copy and the renewal count is below the maximum allowed.
The system shall send an automated reminder three days before a loan falls due.
Every change to a loan record must be written to an audit trail capturing the member, the item, the action and a timestamp.
The loan table shall enforce that the due date is never earlier than the checkout date for any row.

-- schema fragment for the lending module
CREATE TABLE loan_record (
    loan_id          BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    member_id        VARCHAR(40)  NOT NULL,
    copy_id          VARCHAR(40)  NOT NULL,
    checked_out_on   DATE         NOT NULL,
    due_on           DATE         NOT NULL,
    returned_on      DATE,
    renewal_count    SMALLINT     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CONSTRAINT loan_member_fk FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES member_account(member_id),
    CONSTRAINT loan_copy_fk   FOREIGN KEY (copy_id)   REFERENCES item_copy(copy_id),
    CONSTRAINT due_after_checkout CHECK (due_on >= checked_out_on),
    CONSTRAINT renewal_non_negative CHECK (renewal_count >= 0)
);

CREATE INDEX loan_open_by_member ON loan_record (member_id) WHERE returned_on IS NULL;

-- reference tables for reservations
CREATE TABLE reservation (
    reservation_id  BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    member_id       VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    title_id        VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    placed_at       TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    status          VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT reservation_member_fk FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES member_account(member_id),
    CONSTRAINT reservation_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('WAITING','READY','COLLECTED','CANCELLED'))
);
-- fines ledger table
CREATE TABLE charge_ledger (
    charge_id     BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    member_id     VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    amount        NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    reason        VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    recorded_on   DATE          NOT NULL,
    settled       BOOLEAN       NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    CONSTRAINT charge_amount_positive CHECK (amount >= 0)
);

requirement: A member's personal details and loan history must never be exposed to other members through the catalogue interface.
Barcode scanning at the returns desk shall match the scanned code to the oldest open loan for that copy and close it.
